Quotes and Payment

Do you charge for a quote?

No. Quotes are free and there’s no obligation. We look at the roof, tell you what we found and send a written price.

How do I get a quote?

Call 07896 410119, WhatsApp 07926 251213, or fill in the contact form, which opens WhatsApp with your details filled in.

How much does a roof repair or a new roof cost?

It depends on the size of the roof, the materials and how we get up there, so we price each job after seeing it. A ridge or a few tiles is a small job; a full re-roof is a much bigger one.

Can I pay by card?

Yes, cards are accepted.

The Work

Can you find a leak other roofers couldn’t?

Zak often puts a drone up first to see the whole roof before anyone climbs it. Catherine Beswick’s review on Google describes a leak that previous roofers had charged for and not fixed; there have been no leaks since. More on roof repairs.

Will I see what you’ve done?

Yes. Zak takes photos while the work is going on, so you can see the problem and the repair without going up yourself. Several of our reviews mention it.

Do you need scaffolding?

A re-roof is done from scaffolding. Smaller jobs such as ridge tiles are often done from a specialist ladder, with no scaffold to pay for.

Do you do emergency repairs?

Yes. If water is coming in, call 07896 410119 and we’ll get the roof made safe and stop more damage before the permanent repair.

Do you do flat roofs?

Yes, repairs and replacements, including GRP fibreglass. See flat roofing.

About Us

Who will actually do the work?

Coburn Roofing is a father and son team of 3: Steve, with 41 years in roofing, and Zak, with 15. Read more about us.

How long have you been going?

The family business was established in 1981.

Where We Work

Where are you based?

Strelley, on the west side of Nottingham (NG8).

Which areas do you cover?

Nottingham, Derby, Mansfield, Leicester and Newark, plus Arnold, Ilkeston and Belper. See areas we cover, or call if you’re not sure.

Still got a question?

Ask Zak directly. Quotes are free.
